condition: recombinant WT shell expressed in E. coli; pH 3 disassembly followed by neutral-pH reassembly; stable incomplete assembly intermediate
notes: Stable incomplete WT shell assembly intermediate containing 54 Enc monomers. The particle has a single opening and retains an overall icosahedral-like organization, but is measurably distorted, appearing flattened in one direction and elongated in the perpendicular direction.
